picks.quote: Give me Miami plus seven in the first play.
picks.reason: Miami is a competitive underdog with a familiar coach against a banged-up Detroit team.
picks.edge: Miami is improving with quarterback Willis and first year coach Hathley, who is familiar with Detroit.

picks.quote: Give me Carolina plus three in the second game here.
picks.reason: Carolina is a home underdog with a chance to bounce back after a loss.
picks.edge: Carolina has extra rest and is getting back some starters against a struggling Denver team.
